draw_order_64_process_debug_qualificatio.interpretation: All 64 distinct GPU accumulation orders remain finite with identical coverage and exact routing. The worst FP16 order-dependent error remains inside every frozen threshold.

high_overdraw_instance_stream_debug_qual.interpretation: The production bound is one ECS entity, one packet, and one Vulkan draw. CPU packet sorting is eliminated; the remaining 65,536-tier cost is the intended fragment workload and one bounded 4 MiB host upload.

representative_native_4k_release_qualifi.interpretation: The 256-particle four-layer field measures 18053612 fragment invocations, approximately 2.18 fullscreen equivalents at native 4K. The 4096/65536 tiers are robustness stress, not the around-one-fullscreen performance workload.

populated_native_4k_release_baseline.interpretation: The 256 independent draws sustain about 314 GPU frames/s at native 4K on the reference RTX 4090. This establishes populated-path cost, not the required multi-process high-overdraw acceptance result.
